transcript: this production of Romeo and Juliet starring Tom Holland really bothered me but before I talk about what the reasons were I wanna be very clear about what the reasons were not cause this was directed by Jamie Lloyd and he's very divisive and if you don't like his work he's kind of an easy target but I do like him and a lot of the things that he normally does in his productions he also did here like the general aesthetic the like sparse design the non literal use of space, all that stuff none of that bothered me I was also not bothered by the actors I thought they all did an extremely good job with what they were told to do and in theory I don't mind that he was trying to play around with the tone in the pacing so like usually Romeo and Juliet is a lot more fast paced and has a lot more levity I never like to criticize revivals because of what they're quote unquote “supposed” to be I've seen hamlet done as a comedy and I've seen Midsummer Night's Dream done as a drama and I loved it but in this case I think it was a big swing and a miss this is the seventh Jamie Lloyd production I've seen and I think what he's really good at is using the sparse design and the understated tone to create this palpable sense of tension that you could cut with a knife and it worked really well for me in a Doll's House and betrayal and the effect because those plays are kind of driven by these little psychological nuances between the characters so there's a lot happening in the silences and it creates this feeling of like “oh my god what is she gonna say next? what did he really mean when he said that?” But Shakespeare traditionally does not have a lot of subtext it's all kind of on the page now I've seen Shakespeare productions that DID find subtext and were able to use the like silences and the little nuances to shed new light on the text and that to me is what was missing here: they didn't find anything new in the text by delivering it so slowly and laboriously and understated so it just sucked all of the energy out of the play and it just really took a nose dive especially in the second half. when the production is more intense and dynamic there are glimpses of what this production could have been I think it could have been really good with a lot of the same elements in place but it just did not come together for me
